correctness.rationale: For every fixed d≥3 and arbitrary positive (including repeated) side lengths, reconstruct the iid difference density V^{-1}prod_i(1-|z_i|/a_i)_+, integrate monomials over the radius-r Euclidean ball for r≤a_* to recover coefficients c_{d,k}e_k/V, and use e_d=1/V with Vieta to identify the whole length multiset from exactly d leading nonzero coefficients. At pairwise-distinct reciprocal edges, changing only e_{d-1} preserves the first d-1 coefficients and all roots remain positive. Just above a_*, shortest-axis truncation caps are disjoint for r<sqrt(2)a_*; beta integration gives the strictly positive 8m*kappa_(d-1)*(2a_*)^((d-1)/2)/(a_*V(d+1)(d+3))*epsilon^((d+3)/2) plus O_K(epsilon^((d+4)/2)). Dimension identification and feasibility bounds follow from beta_d>0 and positive root polynomial. Independent separately written Python verifier crosschecked d=3,4,5 inverse roots, exact cube polynomial, 5 families of numerical cap corrections including repeated shortest edges and perturbations preserving first d-1 coefficients. These finite computations are corroboration, not the all-d proof.

value.rationale: The Euclidean separation of two independently uniform points of a box is a canonical geometric-probability observable; exact recovery of all unknown edge lengths from the smallest possible local CDF jet, with full positive-root feasibility, is a natural inverse/tomographic invariant. The first-break radius yields the shortest edge and the cusp constant counts its multiplicity, independently linking geometry to a sharp distributional phase boundary. These exact all-dimensional statements and minimality can serve future shape-inference and geometric-probability work, without asserting noise stability or a downstream universal theorem. The novelty does not lie in basic triangular convolution, known 2D forward formulas, or the equal-edge cube case.
